BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-FigureStyle
BundleInfo.Author: Lukas W. Bauer (AI-assisted development by Claude, Anthropic)
BundleInfo.Synopsis: Named style templates and batch rendering for publication figures
BundleInfo.Description: FigureStyle lets you define, save, and apply named visual style templates in ChimeraX. Templates store lighting, background, silhouettes, cartoon style, and export settings. A batch renderer applies a template to a folder of structures and saves PNG images.

Classifiers.ChimeraXClassifier: ChimeraX :: Tool :: FigureStyle :: General :: Publication figure style templates and batch rendering
ChimeraX :: Command :: figurestyle apply :: General :: Apply a named style template to the current session
